guards.rationale: Ovicopter.cs:46 CanLay => CombatState.GetTeammatesOf(Creature).Count(c => c.IsAlive) <= 3, and CombatState.cs:394-400 documents and implements GetTeammatesOf as 'all teammates of a creature, INCLUDING the creature itself' (GetCreaturesOnSide(creature.Side)). ovicopter.py:97-101 counts every living entry of combat.enemies, which likewise includes the Ovicopter. So both sides lay again at <= 2 living eggs, not <= 3. Reading GetTeammatesOf as 'the others' would have made this a false gap. CombatState.cs is in extra_sources.

guards.what: egg slot placement in the enemy list
guards.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-28, RE-OPENED the same day: the fix reproduces Ovicopter.cs:87's `Slots.LastOrDefault(unoccupied)` only for a FRESH slot row, because the sim's eggs must occupy a CONTIGUOUS run at the front of the list. CLOSED: the parity/legacy fork is gone and the first lay now matches -- Ovicopter._lay_eggs (sts2_rl/monsters/hive/ovicopter.py:128-152) computes `idx = min(i for i, c in enumerate(ctx.enemies) if c is self or (isinstance(c, ToughEgg) and not c.is_gone))` and calls `CreatureCmd.add(ctx.hooks, egg, index=idx)` unconditionally, so the opening lay produces [egg, egg, egg, Ovicopter] where it used to produce the Ovicopter FIRST. STILL OPEN: that index is always IN FRONT of every live egg, so a slot freed in the MIDDLE of the row is never refilled in place. The game picks the LAST free entry of OvicopterNormal.Slots ([egg1..egg5, ovicopter], OvicopterNormal.cs:16) and then re-sorts Enemies by Slots.IndexOf -- CreatureCmd.cs:68-69 calls CombatState.AddCreature (which appends) and then CombatManager.AddCreature, which runs `_state.SortEnemiesBySlotName()` whenever `creature.SlotName != null` (CombatManager.cs:841-851 -> CombatState.SortEnemiesBySlotName, CombatState.cs:495-501). EXECUTED 2026-07-28 against the real sim (CombatState(encounter=OVICOPTER_NORMAL, rng=random.Random(4))): the first lay gives ['E3','E2','E1','Ovi'] (matches the game); then killing E1 -- the FIRST-laid egg, which sits in game slot egg5 next to the Ovicopter -- and running _lay_eggs again gives the sim ['N3','N2','N1','E3','E2','Ovi'] where the game gives ['N3'(egg1),'N2'(egg2),'E3'(egg3),'E2'(egg4),'N1'(egg5),'Ovicopter']: N1 sits at enemy index 2 in the sim and index 4 in the game. LIVE main-line play -- SUMMON_BRANCH only lays again when alive <= 3, i.e. only after the player kills an egg, and only killing the LEFTMOST egg reproduces the game's order, so 2 of the 3 choices diverge. The observables are the ones this record already lists: index-addressed targeting, enemy turn order and the obs vector's enemy order. NOTE the cited probe cannot see this: `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py ovicopter-hp` exercises only the FIRST lay, which is exactly the case the approximation gets right. WAS: the legacy branch appended, so even the first lay came out reversed. Rule 7: src/Core/Combat/CombatManager.cs, src/Core/Commands/CreatureCmd.cs and sts2_rl/cmds.py are cited without being hashed by this record.

guards.what: the three-egg loop and the five-slot ceiling
guards.rationale: C# loops i < 3 and skips (text == null) when no slot is free (Ovicopter.cs:85-93); ovicopter.py:130-134 loops 3 times and breaks at >= _EGG_SLOTS = 5 live eggs. Equivalent: slots only get scarcer inside the loop, so skip and break coincide, and 5 is exactly the number of egg slots OvicopterNormal.cs:17 declares (six slots minus the Ovicopter's own). A dead egg frees its slot on both sides - the C# predicate scans CombatState.Enemies, which a killed egg has left, and the sim counts only `not e.is_gone` eggs. Executed: the probe above lays exactly 3.

guards.what: MinionPower is applied to each egg after it is added
guards.rationale: Ovicopter.cs:90-91 awaits CreatureCmd.Add<ToughEgg> and then applies MinionPower 1m with the Ovicopter as applier; ovicopter.py:150-153 keeps the add-then-apply order and the applier. Order matters: the egg's own HatchPower is applied first (during Add / during construction), and HatchMove later strips every power EXCEPT minion.

SmashDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 17, 16) -> 16; TenderizerDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 8, 7) -> 7 followed by VulnerablePower 2m to the targets; NutritionalPasteStrengthAmount (DeadlyEnemies, 4, 3) -> 3 (Ovicopter.cs:34-38, 117). Sim _SMASH_DMG=16, _TENDERIZER_DMG=7, _TENDERIZER_VULN=2, _PASTE_STR=3, with damage before the debuff.
